title: Latvian government judges itself to have done pretty well
summary_full: On November 6th, 2026, the Cabinet of Ministers reviewed a report prepared by the State Chancellery on the implementation of the action plan of the government led by Andris Kulbergs. According to its findnings, by October 15th, 2026, 52 out of 61 priority ministerial tasks, or 85%, had been completed, as well as 132 or 71% of the total 185 measures included in the government action plan.
